name: SERVER_ENTRY
normal_context_day: Corporate office corridor and server room entrance. Staff walking through and authorized IT personnel entering with keycard are normal.
normal_context_night: Corridor quiet and lights dimmed. Routine security patrols are normal. Flag forced door tampering or equipment damage.

name: 1ST_ENTRANCE
normal_context_day: Main 1F entrance corridor with turnstiles. Staff walking in, scanning badges, and carrying laptops or bags are normal.
normal_context_night: Entrance quiet after hours. Routine security guard patrols are normal. Flag jumping turnstiles, forced entry, or intrusion.

name: PARKING
normal_context_day: Basement parking zone. Employees parking cars/bikes, walking to the elevator, and getting in or out of vehicles are normal.
normal_context_night: Quiet parking lot with parked vehicles and dim lighting. Flag vehicle tampering, break-ins, theft, or loitering.

name: 1ST_OUT
normal_context_day: Elevator lobby and 1F corridor area. People walking through, waiting for the elevator, or chatting calmly are normal.
normal_context_night: Quiet lift area. Flag violent scuffles, vandalism, or someone collapsed on the floor.

name: ADMIN_CABIN
normal_context_day: Executive admin office. Employees seated at desks, using laptops/monitors, walking through the office, talking, and carrying items are normal.
normal_context_night: Admin office unoccupied, computers in sleep mode, lights dimmed. Flag unauthorized intrusion or physical theft.

name: 1ST_EXIT
normal_context_day: Corridor exit doors. Employees walking out to go home or take breaks are normal.
normal_context_night: Exit doors locked after hours. Flag kicking doors, forced exits, or suspicious loitering.

name: RECEPTION
normal_context_day: Front desk reception. Staff seated at reception desk, visitors signing in, and people walking past are normal.
normal_context_night: Reception area quiet with lights dimmed. Flag unauthorized trespass, jumping over the reception counter, or theft.
